nodes.label: Help: Devices, accounts and profiles
nodes.rationale: User-facing documentation explaining account sign-in, collections, profiles, and multi-device synchronization

nodes.label: Accounts (optional)
nodes.rationale: Sign in with Google or email to sync library across devices; optional for local-only usage

nodes.label: Collections
nodes.rationale: Each account owns its collections, viewable and editable on every device; same file on two computers is one song with copies on each

nodes.label: Profiles (artist aliases)
nodes.rationale: Artist names that are the same on every device; each device picks which alias to use

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud
nodes.rationale: Optional cloud service keeping library data in step across devices, never music

nodes.label: Clash resolution box
nodes.rationale: When the same song or playlist was changed differently on two devices before sync, asks user to keep this device's, take other's, or merge both
